subject: Physics
title: Wave Optics
summary: Wave optics light ko wave maan kar woh baatein samjhaata hai jo ray optics nahi kar sakta: interference, diffraction aur polarisation. Huygens ke anusaar wavefront ka har point ek naya source hai; inke secondary wavelets milkar agla wavefront banate hain — isi se reflection aur refraction ke niyam bhi nikalte hain.

Do coherent sources (same frequency, constant phase difference) ki waves milein to kahin bright (constructive) aur kahin dark (destructive) fringes — interference. Young's double slit mein fringe width β = λD/d.
Ek hi slit se bhi light thoda mudti hai aur pattern banta hai — diffraction. Central bright fringe sabse chaudi aur chamakdaar (width 2λD/a); pehla dark fringe a sinθ = λ par.

Light transverse wave hai, isliye polarise ho sakti hai. Polaroid sirf ek direction ka vibration jaane deta hai; do polaroids ke beech Malus' law I = I₀cos²θ. Reflection se bhi polarisation hota hai — Brewster angle par reflected light poori polarised.

formulas.name: Path difference and phase difference
formulas.note: λ us medium ki wavelength lo jisme path hai (λ/n).

formulas.name: Resultant intensity of two waves
formulas.formula: I = I₁ + I₂ + 2√(I₁I₂) cosφ;   equal: I = 4I₀ cos²(φ/2)
formulas.mistake: Incoherent sources mein sirf I₁ + I₂ — cos wala term nahi.

formulas.name: Maxima and minima intensities
formulas.mistake: Amplitude ratio diya ho to pehle square karo — intensity ratio nahi hai.

formulas.name: Constructive and destructive conditions
formulas.mistake: Dark ke liye (2n − 1)λ/2 hai, nλ/2 nahi.

formulas.name: YDSE fringe width and positions
formulas.formula: β = λD/d;   nth bright: y = nλD/d;   nth dark: y = (2n − 1)λD/2d;   angular width = λ/d
formulas.mistake: D aur d mix mat karo: D screen ki doori (badi), d slits ki doori (chhoti).

formulas.name: YDSE in a medium
formulas.mistake: Fringe width ghatti hai, badhti nahi.

formulas.name: Thin film in front of one slit
formulas.when: Ek slit ke aage glass sheet.
formulas.mistake: Pattern us slit ki taraf khisakta hai jahan sheet lagi hai; fringe width nahi badalti.

formulas.name: Single-slit diffraction
formulas.formula: Minima: a sinθ = nλ;   central max angular width = 2λ/a;   linear width = 2λD/a
formulas.mistake: YDSE ka ulta: yahan a sinθ = nλ DARK deta hai, bright nahi.

formulas.name: Huygens: refraction
formulas.formula: sin i / sin r = v₁/v₂ = n₂/n₁;   λ₂ = λ₁ v₂/v₁;   f same
formulas.mistake: Medium badalne par frequency kabhi nahi badalti.

formulas.name: Brewster's law
formulas.formula: tan θ_B = n;   θ_B + r = 90° (reflected ⊥ refracted)
formulas.mistake: Brewster par reflected light poori polarised, refracted sirf partly.

formulas.name: Malus' law
formulas.formula: I = I₀ cos²θ;   unpolarised light polaroid se: I₀/2
formulas.mistake: Pehle polaroid par unpolarised light aadhi hoti hai — cos² baad mein lagao.

formulas.name: Coherent sources
formulas.formula: Same frequency + constant phase difference;   YDSE/Lloyd's mirror/biprism ek hi source se do banate hain
formulas.mistake: Do alag bulb kabhi coherent nahi hote — pattern turant badal jaata hai.

examples.title: YDSE ke numbers
examples.problem: λ = 600 nm, d = 0.5 mm, D = 1 m. Fringe width, teesra bright aur teesra dark?
examples.solution: β = λD/d = 600 × 10⁻⁹ × 1 / 0.5 × 10⁻³ = 1.2 mm. 3rd bright = 3β = 3.6 mm. 3rd dark = 2.5β = 3 mm.

examples.title: Setup paani mein
examples.problem: Upar wala setup paani (n = 4/3) mein daal diya. Naya fringe width?

examples.title: Intensity ratio
examples.problem: Do coherent sources ki intensities I aur 4I. I_max : I_min?

examples.title: Path difference se intensity
examples.problem: Do barabar sources (I₀ each), λ = 600 nm, kisi point par path difference 150 nm. Intensity?
examples.solution: φ = 2π × 150/600 = π/2. I = 4I₀ cos²(π/4) = 2I₀ (max ka aadha).

examples.title: Single slit
examples.problem: a = 0.2 mm, λ = 500 nm, screen D = 2 m. Pehle minimum ka angle aur central max ki width?

examples.title: Brewster angle
examples.problem: n = √3 wali glass ka Brewster angle aur us waqt refraction angle?

examples.title: Do polaroids
examples.problem: Unpolarised light I₀ do polaroids se guzarti hai jinke axes ke beech 60°. Final intensity?
examples.solution: Pehle ke baad I₀/2. Doosre ke baad (I₀/2)cos²60° = (I₀/2)(1/4) = 0.125I₀ (12.5%).

examples.title: Glass sheet se fringe shift
examples.problem: YDSE mein ek slit ke aage 6 μm moti glass sheet (n = 1.5), λ = 600 nm. Kitne fringes khiskenge?
examples.solution: N = (n − 1)t/λ = 0.5 × 6 × 10⁻⁶ / 600 × 10⁻⁹ = 5 fringes, sheet wali slit ki taraf.

examples.title: Glass mein light
examples.problem: 600 nm (hawa) light glass (n = 1.5) mein jaati hai. Speed, wavelength, frequency?
examples.solution: v = c/n = 2.0 × 10⁸ m/s. λ = 600/1.5 = 400 nm. f = c/λ_air = 5.0 × 10¹⁴ Hz — dono media mein same.

topics.title: Wavefront and Huygens' principle
topics.explain: Wavefront = same phase wale points ki surface (point source se spherical, door se plane). Huygens: wavefront ka har point secondary wavelet chhodta hai; un sabko chhoone wali surface naya wavefront. Ray hamesha wavefront ke perpendicular.

topics.title: Huygens se reflection aur refraction
topics.explain: Plane wavefront surface par tircha pahunche to har point par wavelet banta hai. Same medium mein wavelets same speed se ⇒ i = r (reflection). Doosre medium mein speed v₂ ⇒ sin i/sin r = v₁/v₂ (Snell's law). Isse pata chala ki ghane medium mein light dheemi hai (Newton ki corpuscular theory ulta kehti thi).

topics.title: Coherent sources and sustained interference
topics.explain: Stable pattern ke liye sources coherent hon (same f, constant phase), amplitudes lagbhag barabar, slits patli aur paas. Do alag bulb coherent nahi — unka phase har 10⁻⁸ s mein random badalta hai.

topics.title: Young's double slit experiment
topics.explain: Ek source ki light do patli slits se do coherent sources banati hai. Screen par barabar chaudai ke bright-dark fringes; centre bright. White light se centre white aur baaki coloured fringes. Energy nashat nahi hoti — sirf redistribute hoti hai.

topics.title: Diffraction due to a single slit
topics.explain: Slit ka har hissa wavelet bhejta hai; θ par jab slit ke do aadhe hisson ka path difference λ/2 ho, sab cancel ⇒ a sinθ = λ par pehla dark. Central max baaki sabse do guna chauda. Slit patli karo to pattern failta hai.

topics.title: Interference vs diffraction
topics.explain: Interference: do (ya zyada) alag wavefronts, sab fringes barabar chaudi aur lagbhag barabar bright. Diffraction: ek hi wavefront ke hisse, central fringe chaudi aur sabse bright, baaki dheere-dheere fade.

topics.title: Polarisation and its uses
topics.explain: Light transverse hai — vibrations ek plane mein seemit kiye ja sakte hain. Polaroid, reflection (Brewster), scattering (aasmaan ki light partly polarised) se polarisation. Uses: sunglasses (glare kam), 3D movie glasses, LCD screens, stress analysis, camera filters.
